title: [Workspace]: Prove adapter readiness with independent external consumers

intent.outcome: Complete GitHub #2200 with clean-environment Python and TypeScript consumers that install only public package artifacts, execute the supported readiness matrix outside the source checkout, and prove removal/no-residue and reverse-dependency boundaries.
non_goals: Do not ship a vendor-specific adapter, plugin lifecycle, registry, credential flow, or marketplace integration.
Do not import AW source-checkout modules, private generated paths, or raw managed workspace files from the consumer fixtures.
Do not claim unsupported operations ready; reconcile the final report with the closed #2044 authority work and current operation-specific conformance receipts.

parent.contribution: Provide the independent outside-the-package closure proof for the #2194 adapter-foundation lane after #2195-#2199 and #2044 landed.
parent.closure_boundary: Close #2200 only when both language consumers pass the full external scenario, cleanup, and boundary proof; keep #2194 open until its parent-level reconciliation is explicit.

.agentic-workspace/planning/** and .agentic-workspace/verification/** for current proof and closeout state
effects: Build Python and TypeScript package artifacts, install them into isolated consumer environments outside the repository tree, and invoke only documented public exports.
Exercise absent, enabled, disabled, incompatible, malformed/failure, optional-module, necessary-surface, and full-mirror scenarios with the bounded read and mutation set from #2198.
Record pre/post repository state, consumer removal, ordinary AW command validity, dependency/import scans, and final supported-operation readiness evidence.

refs: GitHub #2198 is closed by merged PR #2467

next_action: Create the implementation PR, then require exact-head CI and semver-label success before moving the lane to review-ready or complete.

claims: Independent Python and TypeScript consumers install only released/generated public artifacts and use no source-checkout or private imports.
Both consumers negotiate current support metadata and preserve exact structured success, failure, mutation, and additive-field semantics across required scenarios and footprints.
Consumer removal leaves checked-in AW state unchanged, ordinary AW commands valid, and AW packages free of reverse dependencies on the fixtures.
The final readiness report advertises only operations backed by current #2044 authority and operation-specific conformance evidence.
requirements: Run the maintained independent-consumer proof in clean temporary environments with both Python and Node available.
Run focused fixture/runner tests plus operation conformance and generated-package freshness checks selected by implement --changed.
Inspect package/import/dependency scans and before/after tree/status evidence manually before claiming no residue or reverse dependency.
Require exact-head CI and semver-label success before review readiness.
